profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer | AWS & Azure | DevOps | Terraform | Kubernetes | CI/CD Automation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and modernized cloud-native platform services by migrating legacy Java applications to AWS Lambda and event-driven architectures, improving scalability, reliability, and operational efficiency. Built infrastructure automation with Terraform and Serverless Framework, developed resilient multi-region failover solutions, and maintained CI/CD platforms supporting mission-critical applications and development teams across the enterprise.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and deployed cloud-native Java services and REST APIs within Kubernetes environments while building Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines that streamlined application delivery. Collaborated across engineering teams to troubleshoot production services, improve deployment reliability, and integrate frontend and backend systems at scale.
